entities.summary: Justus Scharowsky is a field hockey player from Germany, who plays for French club Racing Club de France. The midfielder made his international senior debut for the German team on 10 July 1999 in a friendly against South Korea in Leipzig. As of 12 November 2005, Scharowsky earned 93 caps for his native country, in which he scored fifteen goals.
